statement: For canonical integer grades K != J, the completed logarithmic derivative cross-grade difference Delta G_{K,J}(s) = -xi_K'(s)/xi_K(s) - (-xi_J'(s)/xi_J(s)) is identically equal to the scalar constant (K-J) log tau on all of Complex plane. In the Hadamard product expansion xi(s) = xi(0) prod_rho (1 - s/rho), the singular zero-pole parts sum_rho 1/(s - rho) cancel unconditionally between grades K and J for every zero configuration. This identity is an exact theorem of scalar coordinate preservation and supplies zero residual information from the zero displacement delta, establishing that scalar logarithmic-derivative differences provide no off-line exclusion mechanism.
